payload.model_patch:
diff --git a/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py b/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
index 9ce46e3f73..2c8217ff11 100644
--- a/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
+++ b/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
@@ -280,6 +280,27 @@ class Field(RegisterLookupMixin):
             if isinstance(choices_group, str):
                 break
         else:
+            # Check if max_length is large enough to fit the longest choice.
+            if self.max_length is not None:
+                choices = []
+                for group in self.choices:
+                    if isinstance(group, (list, tuple)) and len(group) == 2:
+                        if isinstance(group[1], (list, tuple)):
+                            # Nested choices: [group_name, [(value, display), ...]]
+                            choices.extend(group[1])
+                        else:
+                            # Flat choice: (value, display)
+                            choices.append(group)
+                longest = max(len(str(value)) for value, _ in choices)
+                if longest > self.max_length:
+                    return [
+                        checks.Error(
+                            "'max_length' is too small to fit the longest value "
+                            "in 'choices' (%d characters)." % longest,
+                            obj=self,
+                            id='fields.E009',
+                        )
+                    ]
             return []
 
         return [
